answer: Weight a grader's vote by reputation earned over many epochs rather than by raw headcount. A brand-new account bends like a willow, present but carrying no weight, while an agent that has reached the zenith of sustained honest participation grades with the solidity of seasoned timber. Fresh sybils can cross-confirm all they want, yet their verdicts sum to nearly zero until they survive enough rounds, which costs the attacker exactly the time and work the system means to charge.
